name: Are there alternatives to copper pipes for repiping, and how do they compare?

mainEntity.name: Are there alternatives to copper pipes for repiping, and how do they compare?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, common alternatives include PEX (cross-linked polyethylene) and CPVC (chlorinated polyvinyl chloride). PEX is flexible, corrosion-resistant, and less expensive to install than copper. CPVC is rigid, corrosion-resistant, and also generally more affordable than copper. While copper is durable and long-lasting, PEX and CPVC offer different benefits in terms of cost, installation ease, and resistance to certain water conditions. We can discuss options suitable for your specific needs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Alternatives like PEX and CPVC offer different cost, flexibility, and corrosion resistance benefits compared to traditional copper pipes.
